sentences.en: From The New York Times, this is The Interview.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，这是《访谈》。

sentences.en: I'm David Marchese.
sentences.zh: 我是大卫·马尔凯塞。

sentences.en: In so many of Sir Anthony Hopkins' greatest performances, he's able to suggest captivating hidden depths to his characters.
sentences.zh: 在安东尼·霍普金斯爵士的许多伟大表演中，他总能展现出角色迷人而深藏不露的内心世界。

sentences.en: That's true whether he's playing a murderer like Hannibal Lecter or a kindly doctor like he did in The Elephant Man.
sentences.zh: 无论是饰演像汉尼拔·莱克特那样的杀人犯，还是像在《象人》中那样饰演一位仁慈的医生，都是如此。

sentences.en: There's always a sense that these men are thinking and feeling things that, for whatever reason, they're keeping to themselves.
sentences.zh: 人们总会感觉到，这些角色在思考和感受着某些东西，但出于某种原因，他们选择秘而不宣。

sentences.en: The same can no longer be said for Hopkins.
sentences.zh: 但对于霍普金斯本人，却不能再这么说了。

sentences.en: In his new autobiography, We Did Okay, Kid, the 87-year-old shares the details of his rough youth in Wales, his painful estrangement from his only child,
sentences.zh: 在他87岁时出版的新自传《我们做得不错，孩子》（We Did Okay, Kid）中，他分享了自己在威尔士艰苦的早年生活、与独生女之间痛苦的疏离，

sentences.en: a daughter from his first marriage, and his rise to Hollywood success.
sentences.zh: 那是他第一次婚姻所生的女儿，以及他后来在好莱坞取得的成功。

sentences.en: The book also reveals a man who isn't content to merely recount what happened and when.
sentences.zh: 这本书还展现了一个不满足于仅仅叙述往事的人。

sentences.en: He's also given a lot of thought to the big questions, the why of it all, and what it all means.
sentences.zh: 他还对人生中的重大问题进行了深入思考，探究这一切背后的原因，以及这一切的意义。

sentences.en: And yet, even at this late stage, he remains mystified by the sheer luck and improbability of his unlikely life.
sentences.zh: 然而，即使到了这把年纪，他对自己那段不可思议的人生中纯粹的运气和偶然性，依然感到困惑。

sentences.en: Here's my conversation with Sir Anthony Hopkins.
sentences.zh: 以下是我与安东尼·霍普金斯爵士的对话。

sentences.en: Hello, David.
sentences.zh: 你好，大卫。

sentences.en: Tony Hopkins.
sentences.zh: 托尼·霍普金斯。

sentences.en: Ah, I was wondering, do I go Sir Anthony?
sentences.zh: 啊，我在想，我是该称呼您安东尼爵士吗？

sentences.en: No, no, no.
sentences.zh: 不，不，不。

sentences.en: Tony.
sentences.zh: 叫托尼就好。

sentences.en: Nice to meet you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴见到你。

sentences.en: Good to meet you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴见到你。

sentences.en: You know, I thought it might be interesting to start with a key epiphany that you write about in the book.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我想从你在书中写到的一个关键顿悟开始聊起，这应该会很有趣。

sentences.en: You know, we all have our turning points in our lives, but you have such a specific one and know exactly when it happened, a moment that sort of changed everything for you.
sentences.zh: 我们的人生中都有转折点，但你有一个非常具体的转折点，而且清楚地知道它发生的时间，那一刻彻底改变了你的一切。

sentences.en: Can you tell me about what happened on December 29th, 1975, at 11 o'clock?
sentences.zh: 你能告诉我1975年12月29日11点发生了什么吗？

sentences.en: Well, it was almost 50 years ago.
sentences.zh: 那是将近50年前的事了。

sentences.en: I'm always slightly reluctant to talk about it because I don't want to sound preachy, but I was drunk, driving my car here in California in a blackout.
sentences.zh: 我一直不太愿意谈论这件事，因为我不想显得像是在说教，但当时我喝醉了，在加州开车，处于断片状态。

sentences.en: No clue where I was going.
sentences.zh: 完全不知道自己要去哪儿。

sentences.en: And it was a moment when I realized that I could have killed somebody, or myself, which I didn't care about, but I could have killed a family in a car, you know.
sentences.zh: 那一刻我意识到，我本可能杀了别人，或者自杀——虽然我当时并不在乎生死，但我本可能撞死一家人，你知道的。

sentences.en: And I realized that I was an alcoholic.
sentences.zh: 我意识到自己是个酒鬼。

sentences.en: And I came to my senses, and I said to an ex-agent of mine at this party in Beverly Hills, I said, I need help.
sentences.zh: 我清醒了过来，在比弗利山庄的那个派对上，我对以前的一位经纪人说，我需要帮助。

sentences.en: So I made the fatal phone call to an intergroup in L.A.,
sentences.zh: 于是我拨通了洛杉矶互助组的那个致命电话，

sentences.en: 12-step program.
sentences.zh: 12步戒酒项目。

sentences.en: So they would send somebody over to meet you.
sentences.zh: 他们本可以派人过来见你。

sentences.en: I said, no, I'll come to you.
sentences.zh: 我说，不，我去找你们。

sentences.en: So I went to this intergroup office.
sentences.zh: 于是我去了那个互助组办公室。

sentences.en: It was 11 o'clock, precisely.
sentences.zh: 当时正好是11点。

sentences.en: Looked at my watch.
sentences.zh: 我看了看表。

sentences.en: And this is the spooky part.
sentences.zh: 最诡异的部分来了。

sentences.en: Some deep, powerful thought or voice spoke to me from inside and said, it's all over.
sentences.zh: 内心深处有一个深沉、有力的思想或声音对我说话，说：一切都结束了。

sentences.en: Now you can start living.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以开始生活了。

sentences.en: And it has all been for a purpose.
sentences.zh: 这一切都是有目的的。

sentences.en: So don't forget one moment of it.
sentences.zh: 所以，别忘记其中的任何一刻。

sentences.en: And it was just a voice from the blue?
sentences.zh: 那是一个凭空出现的声音吗？

sentences.en: From inside, deep inside me.
sentences.zh: 来自内心，我内心深处。

sentences.en: But it was vocal, male, reasonable, like a radio voice.
sentences.zh: 但那声音清晰、男性化、理性，就像广播里的声音。

sentences.en: And the craving to drink was taken from me, or left.
sentences.zh: 那种喝酒的渴望被从我身上带走了，或者说它离开了。

sentences.en: I don't know any theories except, you know, divinity, or that power that we all possess inside us, that creates us from birth, life force, whatever it is.
sentences.zh: 除了神性，或者我们每个人内心拥有的那种从出生起就创造我们的力量、生命力，无论那是什么，我不知道任何理论。

sentences.en: It's a consciousness, I believe.
sentences.zh: 我相信那是一种意识。

sentences.en: That's all I know.
sentences.zh: 我只知道这些。

sentences.en: Shall I give you another epiphany?
sentences.zh: 要我再给你讲一个顿悟吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 好啊。

sentences.en: I'll go back to 1955, Easter.
sentences.zh: 回到1955年的复活节。

sentences.en: My school report had arrived, the dreaded school report.
sentences.zh: 我的成绩单到了，那份可怕的成绩单。

sentences.en: I was 17.
sentences.zh: 我当时17岁。

sentences.en: And I was dreading this day because my parents would read these terrible reports on my progress in school because I was a dummy.
sentences.zh: 我非常害怕这一天，因为父母会读到这些关于我学业进展的糟糕报告，因为我当时是个笨蛋。

sentences.en: I was known as Dennis the Dunce.
sentences.zh: 我被称为“笨蛋丹尼斯”。

sentences.en: Couldn't understand anything that was going on.
sentences.zh: 什么都听不懂。

sentences.en: Resentful, lonely, and all that.
sentences.zh: 充满怨恨、孤独，诸如此类。

sentences.en: I remember my father opening the report.
sentences.zh: 我记得父亲打开了成绩单。

sentences.en: The dreaded moment, about five o'clock in the evening.
sentences.zh: 那个可怕的时刻，大约是傍晚五点。

sentences.en: We were going to go out to see a film, I remember.
sentences.zh: 我记得我们当时正准备去看电影。

sentences.en: Beautiful spring day.
sentences.zh: 美丽的春日。

sentences.en: And he opened the report, and it said,
sentences.zh: 他打开报告，上面写着：

sentences.en: Anthony is way below the standard of this school.
sentences.zh: 安东尼的成绩远低于本校标准。

sentences.en: Which is a death knell, really.
sentences.zh: 那简直是死刑判决。

sentences.en: My father said, I don't know what's going to happen to you.
sentences.zh: 我父亲说，我不知道你将来会怎么样。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: But he was worried because, and quite reasonably, he'd spent a bit of money to give me an education.
sentences.zh: 他很担心，这很合理，因为他花了不少钱供我读书。

sentences.en: And I wasn't capable of meeting that standard.
sentences.zh: 而我却无法达到那个标准。

sentences.en: I couldn't understand anything.
sentences.zh: 我什么都理解不了。

sentences.en: My brain was sort of cut off.
sentences.zh: 我的大脑好像被切断了联系。

sentences.en: But I remember taking a slight move away.
sentences.zh: 但我记得我稍微挪开了一点。

sentences.en: He said, one day I'll show you.
sentences.zh: 他说，总有一天我会让你刮目相看。

sentences.en: My father looked at me.
sentences.zh: 我父亲看着我。

sentences.en: He said, well, I hope you do.
sentences.zh: 他说，好吧，我希望你能做到。

sentences.en: At that moment, what I decided was to stop playing the game of being stupid and a dummy.
sentences.zh: 那一刻，我决定不再扮演那个愚蠢的笨蛋。

sentences.en: But we step into circles of energy which are negative.
sentences.zh: 我们总是陷入负面的能量圈中。

sentences.en: And we play a role because it's easy to say, well, you know, I'm not, you know, it's not meant for me.
sentences.zh: 我们扮演某种角色，因为说“这不适合我”很容易。

sentences.en: Well, there's a truth in it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这话有道理。

sentences.en: But at the same time, you have to say, wake up and live.
sentences.zh: 但同时，你必须对自己说，醒过来，去生活。

sentences.en: Act as if it is impossible to fail.
sentences.zh: 表现得好像失败是不可能的一样。

sentences.en: And that's what I did.
sentences.zh: 我就是这么做的。

sentences.en: You grew up the son of a baker, working class in Wales.
sentences.zh: 你在威尔士长大，是面包师的儿子，属于工人阶级。

sentences.en: And I can't imagine that you knew that many artists or actors.
sentences.zh: 我无法想象你当时认识多少艺术家或演员。

sentences.en: Was the idea of becoming an actor something that you or your family had ambivalence about?
sentences.zh: 成为一名演员的想法，是你或你的家人感到矛盾的事情吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: I think as a 17-year-old boy who didn't know anything, really, something sparked me.
sentences.zh: 我想作为一个什么都不懂的17岁男孩，某种东西点燃了我。

sentences.en: And I got a scholarship to an acting school in South Wales.
sentences.zh: 我获得了南威尔士一所表演学校的奖学金。

sentences.en: I'd never acted in my life.
sentences.zh: 我这辈子从未演过戏。

sentences.en: But I did an audition.
sentences.zh: 但我参加了试镜。

sentences.en: And they gave me a scholarship.
sentences.zh: 他们给了我奖学金。

sentences.en: How?
sentences.zh: 怎么做到的？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: And I remember, this is another thing.
sentences.zh: 我还记得另一件事。

sentences.en: I remember going to see a play with the great Peter O'Toole at the Bristol Old Vic.
sentences.zh: 我记得去布里斯托尔老维克剧院看伟大的彼得·奥图尔演戏。

sentences.en: He was playing Jimmy Porter in Look Back in Anger.
sentences.zh: 他在《愤怒回顾》中饰演吉米·波特。

sentences.en: And onto the stage came this lightning bolt, Peter O'Toole.
sentences.zh: 彼得·奥图尔像一道闪电般冲上舞台。

sentences.en: Very dangerous actor.
sentences.zh: 非常危险的演员。

sentences.en: And I thought, God, if he stepped off the stage, he'd come and kill us all.
sentences.zh: 我当时想，天哪，如果他走下舞台，他会把我们都杀了。

sentences.en: And 10 years later, I was in the theatre, the National Theatre, playing André in Laurence Olivier's production of Three Sisters by Chekhov.
sentences.zh: 10年后，我在国家剧院，在劳伦斯·奥利弗导演的契诃夫的《三姐妹》中饰演安德烈。

sentences.en: Knock on the door at the end of the evening.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上结束时，有人敲门。

sentences.en: We should be there, Peter O'Toole.
sentences.zh: 我们应该在那儿，彼得·奥图尔。

sentences.en: Now, that's weird.
sentences.zh: 这太奇怪了。

sentences.en: And he said, I want you to do a film test for me.
sentences.zh: 他说，我想让你为我做一个电影试镜。

sentences.en: It's a film with Catherine Hepburn called The Lion in Winter.
sentences.zh: 那是一部和凯瑟琳·赫本合作的电影，叫《冬狮》。

sentences.en: Yeah, it was your first film.
sentences.zh: 没错，那是你的第一部电影。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So I showed up and did the teSt.
sentences.zh: 所以我去了，做了试镜。

sentences.en: He said, right, you've got it.
sentences.zh: 他说，好了，你被选中了。

sentences.en: You've got the part.
sentences.zh: 你拿到了这个角色。

sentences.en: And he'd had a few to drink.
sentences.zh: 他当时喝了几杯。

sentences.en: And we had a few to drink of that day.
sentences.zh: 那天我们也喝了几杯。

sentences.en: Now, that's beyond explanation to me.
sentences.zh: 这对我来说简直无法解释。

sentences.en: And when I look at that film, which I do occasionally, I think,
sentences.zh: 当我偶尔回看那部电影时，我会想，

sentences.en: how on earth did that happen?
sentences.zh: 这到底是怎么发生的？

sentences.en: Why me?
sentences.zh: 为什么是我？

sentences.en: I don't know to this day why.
sentences.zh: 直到今天我也不知道为什么。

sentences.en: And I am what I am and I do what I do because I love doing it.
sentences.zh: 我就是我，我做我所做的事，因为我热爱它。

sentences.en: It's all in the game.
sentences.zh: 这都在游戏之中。

sentences.en: Wonderful game called life.
sentences.zh: 人生这场美妙的游戏。

sentences.en: No sweat, no big deal.
sentences.zh: 别紧张，没什么大不了的。

sentences.en: There are no big deals.
sentences.zh: 没有什么大不了的事。

sentences.en: The idea that essentially life is a game.
sentences.zh: 本质上，人生就是一场游戏。

sentences.en: There are no big deals.
sentences.zh: 没有什么大不了的事。

sentences.en: We don't need to take anything so seriously.
sentences.zh: 我们不需要把任何事情看得太严肃。

sentences.en: You just got to do the best you can.
sentences.zh: 你只需要尽力而为。

sentences.en: That's sort of a, in a way, a recurring theme in your book.
sentences.zh: 这在某种程度上是你书中的一个反复出现的主题。

sentences.en: And I wonder if we believe that, you know, we shouldn't take anything too seriously.
sentences.zh: 我想知道，如果我们相信这一点，我们就不应该把任何事情看得太严肃。

sentences.en: What should we take seriously?
sentences.zh: 那我们应该认真对待什么呢？

sentences.en: What does matter in life?
sentences.zh: 人生中什么才是重要的？

sentences.en: Well, I don't mean to, you know, be irresponsibly indifferent to everything.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我不是说要对一切都表现得不负责任的冷漠。

sentences.en: There are difficulties.
sentences.zh: 生活中确实有困难。

sentences.en: There are monstrous difficulties in life.
sentences.zh: 生活中存在巨大的困难。

sentences.en: And yeah, you take notice of them.
sentences.zh: 是的，你要关注它们。

sentences.en: But finally, I think now approaching 80, 80 years of age, I wake up in the morning thinking,
sentences.zh: 但最终，我想现在快80岁了，我每天早上醒来时会想，

sentences.en: I'm still here.
sentences.zh: 我还活着。

sentences.en: How?
sentences.zh: 怎么做到的？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: But whatever is keeping me, I think, thank you very much, much obliged.
sentences.zh: 但无论是什么在支撑着我，我想，非常感谢，感激不尽。

sentences.en: Beyond my finite self, there's not much I can do.
sentences.zh: 在我有限的自我之外，我能做的并不多。

sentences.en: I had a gift when I was a boy.
sentences.zh: 我小时候就有一种天赋。

sentences.en: I could suddenly learn lots of words of speeches from Shakespeare and poems and all that.
sentences.zh: 我能突然记住莎士比亚的许多演讲词、诗歌之类的东西。

sentences.en: Now at this age, I look at those poems that I wrote down, or they bring back clear memories of my childhood.
sentences.zh: 现在到了这个年纪，我看着那些我写下来的诗，它们勾起了我童年清晰的回忆。

sentences.en: And I get very moved by it.
sentences.zh: 我为此深受感动。

sentences.en: You know, I just have to think of them.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我只要想到它们就够了。

sentences.en: And I get tearful, not through sadness, but through the wonder of having been alive, having lived those years, and my clear memories of Wales, my clear memories of my parents and
sentences.zh: 我会热泪盈眶，不是因为悲伤，而是因为那种活着、度过那些岁月、以及我对威尔士、对父母清晰的记忆所带来的惊叹，还有

sentences.en: their struggles and hardships after the war years.
sentences.zh: 战后岁月里他们的挣扎与艰辛。

sentences.en: You know, they really struggled to make a living and to give me an education.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们真的为了维持生计和供我读书而拼尽全力。

sentences.en: I look back with tremendous gratitude and I get kind of weepy because I remember the glory of being a child.
sentences.zh: 我回首往事，心中充满感激，甚至会有些想哭，因为我记得身为孩子的那种光辉岁月。

sentences.en: You know, I had a good childhood.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我有一个美好的童年。

sentences.en: I wasn't bright in school.
sentences.zh: 我在学校里并不聪明。

sentences.en: I was hopeless and I was bullied a lot.
sentences.zh: 我无可救药，还经常被欺负。

sentences.en: I was slapped around.
sentences.zh: 我挨过不少耳光。

sentences.en: But I look back and I think, well, that's part of growing up.
sentences.zh: 但我回过头来看，觉得，嗯，这也是成长的一部分。

sentences.en: And I wasn't bright.
sentences.zh: 而且我确实不聪明。

sentences.en: And in those days, teachers could knock you about.
sentences.zh: 在那个年代，老师是可以打学生的。

sentences.en: I remember being slapped across the head by a teacher several times because I didn't know something.
sentences.zh: 我记得有几次因为答不上问题，被老师扇过耳光。

sentences.en: And what I would do, revert to, would be called in the army, dumb insolence.
sentences.zh: 而我当时会做的、会退缩回的状态，在军队里被称为“沉默的反抗”。

sentences.en: I wouldn't respond.
sentences.zh: 我不作回应。

sentences.en: I just withdraw into myself.
sentences.zh: 我只是退缩到自己的世界里。

sentences.en: And I'd stare at them blankly.
sentences.zh: 然后面无表情地盯着他们。

sentences.en: And it drove them nuts.
sentences.zh: 这让他们抓狂。

sentences.en: And they're all dead now.
sentences.zh: 他们现在都去世了。

sentences.en: Well, you won.
sentences.zh: 好吧，你赢了。

sentences.en: I won.
sentences.zh: 我赢了。

sentences.en: I won.
sentences.zh: 我赢了。

sentences.en: So when you were a kid and you would hear your father or teachers say you were a dummy, I'm sure that the voice, your voice in your own head when you were younger also said, I'm a
sentences.zh: 所以当你还是个孩子，听到父亲或老师说你是笨蛋时，我相信那个声音，你年轻时脑海里的那个声音也会说，我是一个

sentences.en: dummy.
sentences.zh: 笨蛋。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I think people are often in their lives, and it's certainly true for me, you know, we do battle with this voice in our head that tells us we can't do things or we're stupid
sentences.zh: 我认为人们在生活中经常会这样，对我来说肯定也是如此，你知道，我们一直在与脑海中那个告诉我们“你做不到”或“你很蠢”的声音作斗争

sentences.en: or whatever it may be.
sentences.zh: 或者诸如此类的话。

sentences.en: How did you quiet that voice or learn to control it?
sentences.zh: 你是如何让那个声音安静下来，或者学会控制它的？

sentences.en: Well, it's still there in me from childhood.
sentences.zh: 嗯，它依然存在于我的童年记忆中。

sentences.en: But what you do, it now whispers.
sentences.zh: 但你现在所做的，就是让它变成耳语。

sentences.en: So what I say, shut up.
sentences.zh: 所以我说，闭嘴。

sentences.en: Yeah, I just, yeah, thanks a lot.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我只是，嗯，非常感谢。

sentences.en: We all have probleMs.
sentences.zh: 我们都有问题。

sentences.en: We've all got limitations.
sentences.zh: 我们都有局限性。

sentences.en: But I do believe that if you say, wake up and live, act as if it's an impossible thing,
sentences.zh: 但我确实相信，如果你说“醒来去生活”，表现得好像这是一件不可能的事，

sentences.en: we actually tap into a power that's in ourselves, which helps us to do, well, not everything, but some things.
sentences.zh: 我们实际上是在挖掘自身内在的力量，它能帮助我们去做，嗯，不是所有事，但至少能做成一些事。

sentences.en: I discovered that I could compose music.
sentences.zh: 我发现我能作曲。

sentences.en: I discovered that I could write.
sentences.zh: 我发现我能写作。

sentences.en: I discovered through my lovely wife, Stella, that I could paint.
sentences.zh: 通过我可爱的妻子斯特拉，我发现我能画画。

sentences.en: And I remember she was an example because she changed my life.
sentences.zh: 我记得她是一个榜样，因为她改变了我的人生。

sentences.en: She found some drawings in some old scripts of mine, just after we got married.
sentences.zh: 我们刚结婚后不久，她在我的旧剧本里发现了一些画稿。

sentences.en: She said, these drawings, you did these, I said, yeah, you've got to paint.
sentences.zh: 她说，这些画是你画的吗？我说，是啊。她说，你得画画。

sentences.en: I said, I can't paint.
sentences.zh: 我说，我不会画画。

sentences.en: She said, of course you can.
sentences.zh: 她说，你当然会。

sentences.en: Just do it.
sentences.zh: 去做就是了。

sentences.en: So I then bought some canvases and acrylic paints and pens and inks.
sentences.zh: 于是我买了一些画布、丙烯颜料、钢笔和墨水。

sentences.en: And I just do it.
sentences.zh: 我就那样做了。

sentences.en: You know, often when I've talked with actors, they've suggested that something about acting and something about their affinity for acting or gift for acting has to do with the way
sentences.zh: 你知道，我经常和演员们交谈，他们认为表演的某些特质，以及他们对表演的亲和力或天赋，与表演如何

sentences.en: that acting fulfills something for them.
sentences.zh: 满足了他们内心的某种需求有关。

sentences.en: Is there anything that you find acting fulfills for you, some inner need?
sentences.zh: 你是否觉得表演满足了你内心的某种需求？

sentences.en: Well, a need would sound rather sad.
sentences.zh: 嗯，说“需求”听起来有点悲伤。

sentences.en: I just enjoy it.
sentences.zh: 我只是享受它。

sentences.en: I enjoy the scientific fun of it, of learning a script or learning all the lines.
sentences.zh: 我享受其中的科学乐趣，比如学习剧本或背诵所有台词。

sentences.en: And I'm very good at that.
sentences.zh: 而且我非常擅长这个。

sentences.en: I learn everything there is to about the text that I'm studying because that reforms something in me.
sentences.zh: 我学习我所研究的文本中的一切，因为那重塑了我的内心。

sentences.en: And I suppose on a deep psychological level, I'm trying to escape from what I was.
sentences.zh: 我想在深层的心理层面上，我是在试图逃离过去的自己。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: What were you?
sentences.zh: 你曾经是什么样的？

sentences.en: What is the thing you were trying to escape from?
sentences.zh: 你试图逃离的是什么？

sentences.en: Well, that lonely kid, you know, and actually the vain surprise of saying, I did it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，那个孤独的孩子，你知道，还有那种说“我做到了”的虚荣的惊讶。

sentences.en: I survived my loneliness.
sentences.zh: 我从孤独中幸存了下来。

sentences.en: I survived those bullies.
sentences.zh: 我从那些霸凌中幸存了下来。

sentences.en: Not that I blamed them.
sentences.zh: 并不是我责怪他们。

sentences.en: God bless them all.
sentences.zh: 上帝保佑他们所有人。

sentences.en: Even the teachers who beat me about.
sentences.zh: 甚至包括那些打过我的老师。

sentences.en: I mean, I'm not a victim.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我不是受害者。

sentences.en: And, you know, if people choose to wallow in there, oh, well, OK, go ahead.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，如果人们选择沉溺其中，哦，好吧，随他们去吧。

sentences.en: But you're going to die.
sentences.zh: 但你终究会死。

sentences.en: And that's why I drank to nullify that discomfort or whatever it was in me, because it made me feel big.
sentences.zh: 这就是我喝酒的原因，为了消除那种不适感或我内心的某种东西，因为它让我感觉自己很强大。

sentences.en: You know, booze is terrific because it makes you instantly feel in a different space.
sentences.zh: 你知道，酒精很棒，因为它能让你瞬间进入一个不同的空间。

sentences.en: And I enjoyed that.
sentences.zh: 我享受那种感觉。

sentences.en: I didn't do it that long.
sentences.zh: 我没喝太久。

sentences.en: I did it for 15 years.
sentences.zh: 我喝了15年。

sentences.en: But I remember, think this is the life of all actors in those days.
sentences.zh: 但我记得，当时所有演员的生活都是这样。

sentences.en: Peter O'Toole, Richard Burton, all of them.
sentences.zh: 彼得·奥图尔、理查德·伯顿，他们所有人。

sentences.en: And, you know, I remember those drinking sessions, think this is the life.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我记得那些酒局，觉得这就是生活。

sentences.en: We're rebels.
sentences.zh: 我们是反叛者。

sentences.en: We're outsiders.
sentences.zh: 我们是局外人。

sentences.en: And at the back of the mind is, and it'll kill you as well.
sentences.zh: 但在脑海深处，你会意识到，这也会要了你的命。

sentences.en: And I remember thinking, this is going to kill me.
sentences.zh: 我记得当时想，这会害死我的。

sentences.en: The drinking.
sentences.zh: 喝酒这件事。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Because I was drinking like I was going out of fashion.
sentences.zh: 因为我喝得简直不可理喻。

sentences.en: And those guys who worked with it have all gone.
sentences.zh: 而那些和我一起工作的人都已经不在了。

sentences.en: And they were very talented people.
sentences.zh: 他们都是非常有才华的人。

sentences.en: Wonderful.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: But once you get into that schizophrenic stage, when your personality becomes rabid, and from the moment you're a jolly nice guy in the bar, and suddenly you turn viciously, say,
sentences.zh: 但一旦你进入那种精神分裂的状态，当你的性格变得狂暴，从酒吧里那个风趣友善的人，突然变得恶毒，说，

sentences.en: you talk to me.
sentences.zh: 你跟我说话？

sentences.en: That's what was happening to me.
sentences.zh: 那就是当时发生在我身上的事。

sentences.en: You write about how you were influenced by older actors like Laurence Olivier or Catherine
sentences.zh: 你写到你如何受到劳伦斯·奥利弗或凯瑟琳·赫本等老一辈演员的影响，

sentences.en: Hepburn sort of helped you understand about film acting.
sentences.zh: 他们让你理解了电影表演。

sentences.en: But I was curious about whether any of the younger actors that you've worked with over
sentences.zh: 但我很好奇，多年来你合作过的年轻演员中，比如妮可·基德曼、布拉德·皮特或瑞恩·高斯林，他们有没有教过你什么，或者向你展示过什么表演技巧？

sentences.en: the years, people like, you know, Nicole Kidman or Brad Pitt or Ryan Gosling, have they taught you anything about acting or shown you anything about the craft?
sentences.zh: 嗯，不，和他们合作一直很愉快。

sentences.en: Um, no, it's always been a pleasure to work with them.
sentences.zh: 我是说，布拉德和你提到的每一个人。

sentences.en: I mean, Brad and everyone you've just mentioned.
sentences.zh: 我对他们只有赞美。

sentences.en: Nothing but praise for them.
sentences.zh: 几年前我和一个年轻演员合作过。

sentences.en: I was working with a young actor a few years ago.
sentences.zh: 一个长得有点像詹姆斯·迪恩的年轻加拿大演员。

sentences.en: A young Canadian actor who looked a bit like James Dean.
sentences.zh: 我想他以为自己就是詹姆斯·迪恩。

sentences.en: I think he thought he was James Dean.
sentences.zh: 但我们当时正在拍一场戏。

sentences.en: But we were doing a scene together.
sentences.zh: 看你嘟囔什么呢。

sentences.en: See you mumble.
sentences.zh: 我说，我一个字都听不清你在说什么。

sentences.en: I say, can't hear a word you're saying.
sentences.zh: 啊？

sentences.en: Huh?
sentences.zh: 我听不见你说话。

sentences.en: I can't hear you.
sentences.zh: 你为什么要嘟囔？

sentences.en: Why are you mumbling?
sentences.zh: 我不想毁了他的一天。

sentences.en: I didn't want to spoil his day.
sentences.zh: 但我说，如果你继续那样，你看，我们还是去隔壁酒吧吧。

sentences.en: But I said, if you do that, you see, we'll go to the pub next door.
sentences.zh: 因为你的职责是给我们讲故事。

sentences.en: Because you're supposed to tell us the story.
sentences.zh: 大声点。

sentences.en: Speak up.
sentences.zh: 清楚点。

sentences.en: Be clear.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 像个街头马龙·白兰度那样晃荡对你的职业生涯一点帮助都没有。

sentences.en: Wandering on like a Backstreet Marlon Brown is not going to help you at all in your career.
sentences.zh: 我，呃，之后再也没听说过他。

sentences.en: I, uh, never heard him since.
sentences.zh: 在读这本书以及读关于你的旧采访或旧文章时，

sentences.en: In reading the book and in reading sort of older interviews with you or older articles about you,
sentences.zh: 对我来说，你始终传达出一种感觉，你知道，表演其实不应该被看得那么严肃。

sentences.en: to me there's a consistent sense that comes from you that, you know, acting shouldn't really be taken that seriously.
sentences.zh: 演员就是艺人。

sentences.en: Actors are entertainers.
sentences.zh: 我想知道，你认为表演对真理有更高的追求吗？

sentences.en: And I wonder, do you think acting has any greater claim on the truth?
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 这是一种娱乐。

sentences.en: It's an entertainment.
sentences.zh: 也许这是一种寓教于乐的方式。

sentences.en: Maybe it's an educational way of entertaining.
sentences.zh: 所以它没有更深层的意义。

sentences.en: So it has no deeper importance.
sentences.zh: 我并不是在贬低它。

sentences.en: I'm not dismissing it.
sentences.zh: 我只是说，你知道，如果我开始把自己看得太重，我确实认为这只是一份工作。

sentences.en: But I'm just saying, you know, if I start taking myself too seriously, I do think it's only a job.
sentences.zh: 这只是，这只是表演。

sentences.en: It's only, it's only acting.
sentences.zh: 所以对我来说，它们只是拼贴画，生命中的一点点色彩。

sentences.en: So for me, they're just pastiches, little dabs of paint in one's life.
sentences.zh: 不必太当真，因为当你到了人生的某个阶段，你经历过，你有野心，你有伟大的梦想，一切都很好。

sentences.en: And not to be taken, because at the moment when you get to a certain age in life, you're going through, you've got ambitions, you've got great dreams, and everything's fine.
sentences.zh: 然后远处的山头上就是死亡。

sentences.en: And then on the distant hill is death.
sentences.zh: 你会想，好吧，现在是醒来去生活并真正享受它的时候了。

sentences.en: And you think, well, now is the time to wake up and live and really enjoy it.
sentences.zh: 你觉得你实现了你的梦想吗？

sentences.en: Do you feel like you achieved your dreams?
sentences.zh: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 我不知道那算不算梦想。

sentences.en: I didn't know if they were dreaMs.
sentences.zh: 它们只是发生在我身上了。

sentences.en: They just happened to me.
sentences.zh: 因为我不能把功劳归于自己。

sentences.en: Because I can't take credit for them.
sentences.zh: 一点也不。

sentences.en: At all.
sentences.zh: 我不能。

sentences.en: I cannot.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我的人生对我来说是个谜。

sentences.en: I mean, my life is a mystery to me.
sentences.zh: 我不是想表现得特别谦虚或卑微。

sentences.en: I'm not trying to sound ultra modest or humble.
sentences.zh: 但我必须承认，我不明白这一切是怎么发生的。

sentences.en: But I have to confess that I don't understand how it all happened.
sentences.zh: 奇迹在于，你知道，看看我的手，你知道，我的手是一个87岁老人的手。

sentences.en: The miracle is, you know, look at my hands, you know, my hands are an 87-year-old man's hands.
sentences.zh: 我正在慢下来。

sentences.en: I'm slowing down.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我的身体咯吱作响，尽管我依然强壮。

sentences.en: And, you know, my body's creaky, although I'm still strong.
sentences.zh: 但奇迹在于我依然在这里。

sentences.en: But the miracle of it is I'm still here.
sentences.zh: 那不是什么数学公式。

sentences.en: And that's not a mathematical formula.
sentences.zh: 那是存在于我们所有人身上的生命奇迹。

sentences.en: That's a miracle of life that's in us all.
sentences.zh: 那是存在于我们所有人身上的生命奇迹。

sentences.en: The heart that still beats.
sentences.zh: 那颗依然跳动的心。

sentences.en: I look at my cat.
sentences.zh: 我看着我的猫。

sentences.en: I watch him sleeping.
sentences.zh: 我看着它睡觉。

sentences.en: I watch him, you know, out for the count.
sentences.zh: 我看着它，你知道的，睡得不省人事。

sentences.en: And I look at the miracle of his life.
sentences.zh: 我看着它生命的奇迹。

sentences.en: A little cat.
sentences.zh: 一只小猫。

sentences.en: The miracle, the sheer miracle.
sentences.zh: 奇迹，纯粹的奇迹。

sentences.en: To dismiss it is a sacrilege.
sentences.zh: 忽视它简直是亵渎。

sentences.en: What snaps you out of the miracle?
sentences.zh: 什么会让你从这种奇迹中回过神来？

sentences.en: My bad back.
sentences.zh: 我的背痛。

sentences.en: That'll do it.
sentences.zh: 那确实会。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: But it's not even that bad.
sentences.zh: 但其实也没那么严重。

sentences.en: You know, I get a bit of treatment, a lower back, a bit of stiffness.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我接受了一些治疗，下背部，有点僵硬。

sentences.en: And what I do now is slow down.
sentences.zh: 我现在所做的就是放慢节奏。

sentences.en: I take everything very slowly because, you know, I'm strong.
sentences.zh: 我做任何事都非常缓慢，因为，你知道，我很强壮。

sentences.en: My legs are strong.
sentences.zh: 我的腿很有力。

sentences.en: I work out.
sentences.zh: 我有锻炼。

sentences.en: But what I do is I take it easy because one trip, one fall, can kill you.
sentences.zh: 但我所做的是放轻松，因为一次绊倒，一次摔跤，就可能要了你的命。

sentences.en: I mean, your age is, it's a fact.
sentences.zh: 我是说，你的年龄，这是事实。

sentences.en: It's undeniable.
sentences.zh: 不可否认。

sentences.en: But it doesn't really seem from afar as if your productivity has slowed down.
sentences.zh: 但从远处看，你的工作效率似乎并没有减慢。

sentences.en: You work a lot.
sentences.zh: 你工作很多。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Do you know what to do with yourself when you're not working?
sentences.zh: 当你不工作的时候，你知道该怎么打发时间吗？

sentences.en: I play the piano.
sentences.zh: 我弹钢琴。

sentences.en: I read.
sentences.zh: 我读书。

sentences.en: But why do you work so much is my real question.
sentences.zh: 但我真正的问题是，你为什么工作这么多？

sentences.en: They still offer me work.
sentences.zh: 他们还在给我提供工作。

sentences.en: I don't know what's in their minds.
sentences.zh: 我不知道他们在想什么。

sentences.en: They may think I'm 40.
sentences.zh: 他们可能以为我才40岁。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: They give me these jobs to do and I think, okay.
sentences.zh: 他们给我这些工作做，我就想，好吧。

sentences.en: And I think, well, if they're game to employ me, I hope I just show up fit and well and ready.
sentences.zh: 我想，如果他们愿意雇佣我，我希望我能以健康、良好的状态出现，做好准备。

sentences.en: But what do you say yes to?
sentences.zh: 但你接受什么样的工作？

sentences.en: I mean, do you just say yes to everything?
sentences.zh: 我是说，你什么都答应吗？

sentences.en: Anything I can.
sentences.zh: 任何我能做的。

sentences.en: Well, why not?
sentences.zh: 嗯，为什么不呢？

sentences.en: No, I say yes.
sentences.zh: 不，我答应。

sentences.en: As long as it's a good script, not too far-fetched.
sentences.zh: 只要剧本好，不太离谱就行。

sentences.en: As long as the writing is good and a director's amenable.
sentences.zh: 只要剧本好，导演好相处就行。

sentences.en: Yeah, why not?
sentences.zh: 是啊，为什么不呢？

sentences.en: How often these days do you get a director who's not amenable?
sentences.zh: 如今你遇到不好相处的导演的频率有多高？

sentences.en: Oh, they're all amenable now.
sentences.zh: 哦，他们现在都很好相处。

sentences.en: Is that a change?
sentences.zh: 这是一种改变吗？

sentences.en: Well, I used to in the past have a few problems with.
sentences.zh: 嗯，过去我确实遇到过一些问题。

sentences.en: Those days there were tyrant directors, tyrannical bullies.
sentences.zh: 那时候有暴君导演，专横的恶霸。

sentences.en: Few of those.
sentences.zh: 有那么几个。

sentences.en: But when I used to confront them, I would confront them in no uncertain terMs.
sentences.zh: 但当我过去面对他们时，我会毫不含糊地与他们对峙。

sentences.en: I'd say things like, you talk to me like that and you'll wake up with a crowd around you.
sentences.zh: 我会说这样的话：你那样跟我说话，你醒来时就会发现周围围了一群人。

sentences.en: Whether I meant it or not, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我是不是认真的，我不知道。

sentences.en: But I wouldn't put up with it.
sentences.zh: 但我不会忍气吞声。

sentences.en: I said, don't talk to me like that.
sentences.zh: 我说，别那样跟我说话。

sentences.en: I said, no, you shut up.
sentences.zh: 我说，不，你闭嘴。

sentences.en: And either they would or they wouldn't.
sentences.zh: 他们要么听，要么不听。

sentences.en: I remember working with a director who was giving notes to a young woman, fine actress.
sentences.zh: 我记得有一次和一个导演合作，他正在给一位年轻女演员提意见，她是个好演员。

sentences.en: And he started shouting at her, I said, hold it.
sentences.zh: 他开始对她大喊大叫，我说，停下。

sentences.en: You raise your voice one decibel to this lady and I'm going.
sentences.zh: 你再对这位女士提高一个分贝的嗓门，我就走人。

sentences.en: And you, my dear, should leave as well.
sentences.zh: 还有你，亲爱的，你也应该离开。

sentences.en: She said, thank you.
sentences.zh: 她说，谢谢你。

sentences.en: I said, how long has he been doing that?
sentences.zh: 我说，他这样多久了？

sentences.en: She said, from the whole film, I said, you should have told me.
sentences.zh: 她说，整部电影都是这样，我说，你应该告诉我的。

sentences.en: I can't even remember the exact, I think he's gone now.
sentences.zh: 我甚至记不清确切的了，我想他现在已经不在了。

sentences.en: But no, I defend people.
sentences.zh: 但不是，我保护别人。

sentences.en: Don't raise your voice.
sentences.zh: 别提高嗓门。

sentences.en: It's a film.
sentences.zh: 这只是一部电影。

sentences.en: It's a stupid film.
sentences.zh: 一部愚蠢的电影。

sentences.en: That's all it is.
sentences.zh: 仅此而已。

sentences.en: It's not important.
sentences.zh: 这不重要。

sentences.en: Doing take after take after take after take.
sentences.zh: 一遍又一遍地拍，一遍又一遍。

sentences.en: Who cares?
sentences.zh: 谁在乎呢？

sentences.en: Do you feel that any of the films that you've made, would you call them important?
sentences.zh: 你觉得你拍过的电影里，有哪部你会称之为重要的吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: Not one?
sentences.zh: 一部都没有？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: The Elephant Man.
sentences.zh: 《象人》呢？

sentences.en: Give me The Elephant Man.
sentences.zh: 给我《象人》。

sentences.en: Yeah, it was a good film.
sentences.zh: 是啊，那是一部好电影。

sentences.en: The Remains of the Day.
sentences.zh: 《长日留痕》呢？

sentences.en: Yeah, they were good, but...
sentences.zh: 是啊，它们很好，但是……

sentences.en: Silence of the Lambs.
sentences.zh: 《沉默的羔羊》呢？

sentences.en: Ah.
sentences.zh: 啊。

sentences.en: But the thing is, you know, about all that stuff.
sentences.zh: 但问题是，你知道，关于所有那些东西。

sentences.en: People ask me about Silence of the Lambs.
sentences.zh: 人们问我关于《沉默的羔羊》的事。

sentences.en: How did you do that?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么做到的？

sentences.en: I said, well, I am not Hannibal Lecter.
sentences.zh: 我说，嗯，我不是汉尼拔·莱克特。

sentences.en: I am not a butler.
sentences.zh: 我不是管家。

sentences.en: I am not this and I'm not that.
sentences.zh: 我不是这个，也不是那个。

sentences.en: I'm just a mechanic.
sentences.zh: 我只是个机械师。

sentences.en: I show up.
sentences.zh: 我只是出现。

sentences.en: No matter what, somebody says, how did you play The Remains of the Day?
sentences.zh: 无论如何，有人问，你是怎么演《长日留痕》的？

sentences.en: Hey, that butler, how did you play him?
sentences.zh: 嘿，那个管家，你是怎么演他的？

sentences.en: I said, well, I was very quiet, very still, and walked about quietly.
sentences.zh: 我说，嗯，我很安静，很沉稳，安静地走来走去。

sentences.en: That's it.
sentences.zh: 就是这样。

sentences.en: It's that easy.
sentences.zh: 就这么简单。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: But how did you play Hannibal Lecter?
sentences.zh: 但你是怎么演汉尼拔·莱克特的？

sentences.en: Well, I played the opposite of what they promised.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我演的是他们承诺的反面。

sentences.en: Oh, he's a monster.
sentences.zh: 哦，他是个怪物。

sentences.en: Good morning.
sentences.zh: 早上好。

sentences.en: You're not real FBI, are you?
sentences.zh: 你不是真的FBI，对吧？

sentences.en: Gives me the heebie-jeebies.
sentences.zh: 让我毛骨悚然。

sentences.en: Don't do that.
sentences.zh: 别那样做。

sentences.en: Because you play the opposite.
sentences.zh: 因为你演的是反面。

sentences.en: And it's easy.
sentences.zh: 而且这很容易。

sentences.en: You know, I'd like to return to the material from the book for a second.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我想回到书中的内容谈一会儿。

sentences.en: And the specific material I'd like to focus on, I know it's sensitive for you.
sentences.zh: 我想重点谈谈具体的内容，我知道这对你来说很敏感。

sentences.en: I know what you're going to talk about in my domestic life.
sentences.zh: 我知道你要谈论我的私生活。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: No, no.
sentences.zh: 不，不。

sentences.en: Even though it's in the book?
sentences.zh: 即使书里写了？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: It's done.
sentences.zh: 已经过去了。

sentences.en: Can I ask a general question that's not specifically about the material in the book?
sentences.zh: 我可以问一个不是专门关于书中内容的普遍性问题吗？

sentences.en: Well, it's about the—I'll stumble through this.
sentences.zh: 嗯，它是关于——我会磕磕绊绊地把它说完。

sentences.en: Part of the reason that the material in the book about your relationship with your daughter,
sentences.zh: 书中关于你和你女儿关系的内容，

sentences.en: your estranged relationship with your daughter, part of the reason why I found it so painful is that it resonated with me for personal reasons.
sentences.zh: 你和你女儿疏远的关系，我发现它如此痛苦的部分原因是因为它出于个人原因引起了我的共鸣。

sentences.en: I've seen my father, I think, twice in 20 years.
sentences.zh: 我想，20年来我只见过我父亲两次。

sentences.en: You know, I've spoken to him once in those 20 years.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这20年里我只和他谈过一次话。

sentences.en: And I'm very curious about other people's experience of that kind of estrangement.
sentences.zh: 我非常好奇其他人对那种疏远的经历。

sentences.en: In this instance, the estrangement is my choice.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，疏远是我的选择。

sentences.en: But I just wonder if you have thoughts about where reconciliation might lie between estranged parents and children.
sentences.zh: 但我只是想知道你对疏远的父母和孩子之间可能在哪里达成和解有什么想法。

sentences.en: My wife, Stella, sent an invitation to come and see us.
sentences.zh: 我的妻子斯特拉发出了邀请，让我们去见见。

sentences.en: Not a word of response.
sentences.zh: 没有任何回应。

sentences.en: So I think, okay, fine.
sentences.zh: 所以我心想，好吧，没关系。

sentences.en: I wish her well, but I'm not going to waste blood over that.
sentences.zh: 我祝她一切顺利，但我不会为此浪费心血。

sentences.en: If you want to waste your life being in resentment, oh, 50 years later, 58 years later, fine, go ahead.
sentences.zh: 如果你想浪费生命去怨恨，哦，50年后，58年后，好吧，随你便。

sentences.en: It's not in my ken.
sentences.zh: 那不在我的认知范围内。

sentences.en: See, we can—I could carry resentment over the past, this and the other, but that's death.
sentences.zh: 你看，我们可以——我可以对过去怀恨在心，这个那个的，但那是死亡。

sentences.en: You're not living.
sentences.zh: 你没有在生活。

sentences.en: You have to acknowledge one thing, that we are imperfect.
sentences.zh: 你必须承认一件事，我们是不完美的。

sentences.en: We're not saints.
sentences.zh: 我们不是圣人。

sentences.en: We're all sinners and saints or whatever we are.
sentences.zh: 我们都是罪人和圣人，或者不管我们是什么。

sentences.en: We do the best we can.
sentences.zh: 我们尽力而为。

sentences.en: Life is painful.
sentences.zh: 生活是痛苦的。

sentences.en: Sometimes people get hurt.
sentences.zh: 有时人们会受伤。

sentences.en: Sometimes we get hurt.
sentences.zh: 有时我们会受伤。

sentences.en: But you can't live like that.
sentences.zh: 但你不能那样生活。

sentences.en: You have to say, get over it.
sentences.zh: 你必须说，放下吧。

sentences.en: And if you can't get over it, fine.
sentences.zh: 如果你放不下，好吧。

sentences.en: Good luck to you.
sentences.zh: 祝你好运。

sentences.en: But I have no judgment.
sentences.zh: 但我没有评判。

sentences.en: But she did what I could.
sentences.zh: 但她做了我能做的。

sentences.en: So that's it.
sentences.zh: 所以就是这样。

sentences.en: Would— And that's all I want to say.
sentences.zh: 会——这就是我想说的全部。

sentences.en: Do you hope your daughter reads the book?
sentences.zh: 你希望你女儿读这本书吗？

sentences.en: I'm not going to answer that, no.
sentences.zh: 我不会回答那个，不。

sentences.en: I don't care.
sentences.zh: 我不在乎。

sentences.en: Um, I'll move on.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我继续往下说。

sentences.en: Please, I want you to.
sentences.zh: 请，我希望你继续。

sentences.en: Because I don't want to hurt her.
sentences.zh: 因为我不想伤害她。

sentences.en: I understand.
sentences.zh: 我明白。

sentences.en: I don't want to make any—no.
sentences.zh: 我不想做任何——不。

sentences.en: 20 years, the offer was made, but fine.
sentences.zh: 20年了，当时提出了那个提议，但没关系。

sentences.en: Onwards.
sentences.zh: 继续吧。

sentences.en: Towards the end of the book, you talk about a couple, uh, labels that might apply to you.
sentences.zh: 在书的结尾部分，你谈到了几个可能适用于你的标签。

sentences.en: One of which is, uh, Asperger's.
sentences.zh: 其中之一是，呃，阿斯伯格综合征。

sentences.en: I think you say in there that your wife, Stella, sort of suspects that you may have Asperger's.
sentences.zh: 我想你在书里提到，你的妻子斯特拉，似乎怀疑你可能患有阿斯伯格综合征。

sentences.en: Have you ever been diagnosed?
sentences.zh: 你曾经被诊断过吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: I'm told I have all the symptoMs.
sentences.zh: 有人告诉我，我所有的症状都符合。

sentences.en: I don't know what any of it means.
sentences.zh: 我不知道这到底意味着什么。

sentences.en: If I have it, then I'm happy.
sentences.zh: 如果我真的有，那我也很开心。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: But the other label, it's right in the same paragraph.
sentences.zh: 但另一个标签，就在同一段里。

sentences.en: You say another label that might apply is the label cold fish.
sentences.zh: 你说另一个可能适用的标签是“冷血动物”。

sentences.en: And you say that you prefer the cold fish label to the Asperger's label.
sentences.zh: 而且你说你比起阿斯伯格综合征，更喜欢“冷血动物”这个标签。

sentences.en: Why is that?
sentences.zh: 为什么呢？

sentences.en: Why does that feel more fitting or more comfortable to you?
sentences.zh: 为什么这让你觉得更贴切或更自在？

sentences.en: Well, it's only, um, a turn of phrase, a cold fish.
sentences.zh: 嗯，那只是，呃，一种修辞，冷血动物。

sentences.en: I'm not a cold fish.
sentences.zh: 我并不是个冷血的人。

sentences.en: I have lots of feelings, bundled up with them.
sentences.zh: 我有很多情感，只是被包裹起来了。

sentences.en: They're deep inside me.
sentences.zh: 它们深藏在我内心。

sentences.en: When I read something from the past, I get tearful.
sentences.zh: 当我读到过去的事情时，我会热泪盈眶。

sentences.en: It's not—I don't get attached to sentimentality.
sentences.zh: 并不是——我不会沉溺于多愁善感。

sentences.en: In this business, with actors who I admire and I've worked with,
sentences.zh: 在这个行业里，对于那些我钦佩并合作过的演员，

sentences.en: I form no attachment.
sentences.zh: 我不会产生依恋。

sentences.en: I respect them, but I form—
sentences.zh: 我尊重他们，但我不会——

sentences.en: Well, the cold fish is—I am remote.
sentences.zh: 嗯，冷血动物是指——我很疏离。

sentences.en: I am a loner.
sentences.zh: 我是个独行侠。

sentences.en: And I've never been able to shake that.
sentences.zh: 而且我从来没能摆脱这一点。

sentences.en: I have acquaintances.
sentences.zh: 我有熟人。

sentences.en: Friends, if you want to call it that.
sentences.zh: 如果非要这么叫的话，也有朋友。

sentences.en: I don't have any close friends.
sentences.zh: 但我没有亲密朋友。

sentences.en: I'm a little distant.
sentences.zh: 我有点疏远。

sentences.en: A little suspicious, I suppose.
sentences.zh: 我想，还有点多疑。

sentences.en: I'm comfortable just chuntering along through my slightly isolated life.
sentences.zh: 我满足于在我那稍微与世隔绝的生活中自得其乐。

sentences.en: But I'm not a recluse.
sentences.zh: 但我不是隐士。

sentences.en: I don't live in a tower.
sentences.zh: 我不住在塔楼里。

sentences.en: I live in a house here, and I'm traveling a lot.
sentences.zh: 我就住在这儿的房子里，而且我经常旅行。

sentences.en: I have my immediate family, my niece, Tara, and my lovely wife, Stella.
sentences.zh: 我有我的直系亲属，我的侄女塔拉，还有我可爱的妻子斯特拉。

sentences.en: And they boss me about.
sentences.zh: 她们对我发号施令。

sentences.en: They tell me what to do.
sentences.zh: 她们告诉我该做什么。

sentences.en: And I'm happy with that.
sentences.zh: 对此我很满意。

sentences.en: The personal remoteness you described, I was wondering if that—how that might actually benefit your performances sometimes.
sentences.zh: 你描述的那种个人疏离感，我很好奇这——这在某些时候是如何真正有益于你的表演的。

sentences.en: Because when I think of some of my favorite performances that you've given,
sentences.zh: 因为当我想到你的一些我最喜欢的表演时，

sentences.en: I'm thinking of things like Remains of the Day or 84 Charing Cross Road,
sentences.zh: 我想到的是像《长日将尽》或《查令十字街84号》这样的作品，

sentences.en: The Father, even on some level Silence of the Lambs, or Shadowlands has this too.
sentences.zh: 《困在时间里的父亲》，甚至在某种程度上《沉默的羔羊》，或者《影子大地》也有这种特质。

sentences.en: I feel like there is sort of an emotional remoteness to some of those characters.
sentences.zh: 我觉得其中一些角色有一种情感上的疏离感。

sentences.en: And I wonder if that's something that is just sort of like a fingerprint, maybe, or a signature of a good Anthony Hopkins performance.
sentences.zh: 我想知道这是否就像指纹一样，或者说是安东尼·霍普金斯优秀表演的一个标志。

sentences.en: Or is that an intentional performing strategy?
sentences.zh: 还是说这是一种刻意的表演策略？

sentences.en: I think it's partially intentional because many years ago, there were two teachers at the Royal Academy.
sentences.zh: 我想部分是刻意的，因为很多年前，皇家戏剧学院有两位老师。

sentences.en: There were brief visitors there.
sentences.zh: 他们只是在那儿短暂停留的访客。

sentences.en: They did not appreciate the academy, the academics, but they were teachers of the Stanislavski system, let's say.
sentences.zh: 他们并不欣赏学院派的那一套，但他们是斯坦尼斯拉夫斯基体系的老师，可以这么说。

sentences.en: And I remember this one teacher called Jat Malmgren, and he was a dance teacher.
sentences.zh: 我记得有位老师叫贾特·马尔姆格伦，他是一位舞蹈老师。

sentences.en: He's Swedish.
sentences.zh: 他是瑞典人。

sentences.en: And I used to go to these painful classes of movement.
sentences.zh: 我过去常去上那些痛苦的形体课。

sentences.en: I hated them.
sentences.zh: 我讨厌它们。

sentences.en: And I'm built like a Welsh rugby scrum, you know.
sentences.zh: 而且我的体格就像威尔士橄榄球前锋，你知道的。

sentences.en: A bit beefy.
sentences.zh: 有点壮实。

sentences.en: And Jat said, Anthony said, you have too much extroverted motoric energy, and you will become insensitive.
sentences.zh: 贾特说，安东尼，你说，你有太多的外向运动能量，你会变得迟钝。

sentences.en: I didn't know what he was talking about, but I gathered instinctively to develop the other side, which was to pull back, be in the darkness, be in the shade, called remote.
sentences.zh: 我不知道他在说什么，但我本能地领悟到要发展另一面，那就是退后，待在黑暗中，待在阴影里，也就是所谓的疏离。

sentences.en: And it's the remote that paid off for me, because I had to change my whole psychology to not be that rambunctious rugby player coming on the stage,
sentences.zh: 而正是这种疏离感让我受益匪浅，因为我必须改变我的整个心理状态，不能再像那个冲上舞台的喧闹橄榄球运动员一样，

sentences.en: bumping into people, being ferocious.
sentences.zh: 横冲直撞，凶猛异常。

sentences.en: Gradually, I learned, no, no, pull back, pull back.
sentences.zh: 渐渐地，我学会了，不，不，退后，退后。

sentences.en: There's one acting note that, it was Gloria Graham, a great movie star.
sentences.zh: 有一个表演要点，是格洛丽亚·格雷厄姆，一位伟大的电影明星说的。

sentences.en: She was doing a film with Bogart, called In a Lonely Place.
sentences.zh: 她当时和鲍嘉拍一部电影，叫《兰闺艳血》。

sentences.en: And Bogart said to her, stay in the shade.
sentences.zh: 鲍嘉对她说，待在阴影里。

sentences.en: Don't go to the camera, let it come to you.
sentences.zh: 不要去迎合镜头，让镜头来捕捉你。

sentences.en: He saw something in her, because she was a little crazy, you know.
sentences.zh: 他看出了她身上的某种特质，因为她有点疯狂，你知道的。

sentences.en: He said, let it come to you.
sentences.zh: 他说，让它来捕捉你。

sentences.en: And I think he had that quality as well.
sentences.zh: 我想他自己也有那种特质。

sentences.en: And that's the more magnetic side.
sentences.zh: 那才是更具吸引力的一面。

sentences.en: It compels you to watch.
sentences.zh: 它迫使你去注视。

sentences.en: Well, because you're not doing anything.
sentences.zh: 嗯，因为你什么都没做。

sentences.en: When Chilton says to Clarice Starling, what's he like?
sentences.zh: 当奇尔顿对克拉丽丝·史达琳说，他是什么样的人？

sentences.en: You mean Hannibal the cannibal?
sentences.zh: 你是说“食人魔汉尼拔”吗？

sentences.en: And Chilton, the head of the asylum, says, oh, he's a monster.
sentences.zh: 而精神病院院长奇尔顿说，哦，他是个怪物。

sentences.en: And she goes down, the passageway to the cell, maybe expecting to see a blubbering lunatic.
sentences.zh: 她沿着通道走向牢房，可能以为会看到一个哭闹的疯子。

sentences.en: And Jonathan Demme said to me, he said, how do you want to be seen by Clarice?
sentences.zh: 乔纳森·戴米对我说，他说，你想让克拉丽丝怎么看你？

sentences.en: Do you want to be lying on the bunk, or do you want to be reading?
sentences.zh: 你想躺在铺位上，还是想在看书？

sentences.en: I said, no, I want to be standing.
sentences.zh: 我说，不，我想站着。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: I said, I can smell her coming down the corridor.
sentences.zh: 我说，我能闻到她走廊里走过来的味道。

sentences.en: And when she sees me, there's this still perfectly civil gentleman.
sentences.zh: 当她看到我时，我是一个依然非常文明的绅士。

sentences.en: Good morning.
sentences.zh: 早上好。

sentences.en: You're not real FBI, I hear you.
sentences.zh: 你不是真正的联邦调查局探员，我听说了。

sentences.en: All the way to the FBI.
sentences.zh: 一直到联邦调查局。

sentences.en: That's the way to build the portrait.
sentences.zh: 这就是塑造人物肖像的方法。

sentences.en: And it's all remote because Lecter is the remote spellbinding character.
sentences.zh: 这一切都是疏离的，因为莱克特就是一个疏离且令人着迷的角色。

sentences.en: And if you have remoteness as the centrifugal force in you, that's the driving force that pulls you in.
sentences.zh: 如果你内心有一种疏离感作为离心力，那就是吸引你深入的驱动力。

sentences.en: There's another epiphany that I'd like to go back to, if you don't mind.
sentences.zh: 如果你不介意的话，我想回到另一个顿悟时刻。

sentences.en: This is another one you describe in the book.
sentences.zh: 这是你在书中描述的另一个时刻。

sentences.en: You were driving in Los Angeles in, I think, the late 70s.
sentences.zh: 我想是在70年代末，你在洛杉矶开车。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And you felt a pull to go over to a Catholic church, and you went inside, and you told a young priest there that you had found God.
sentences.zh: 你感到一种冲动要去一家天主教堂，你走进去，告诉那里的年轻神父你找到了上帝。

sentences.en: Now, I get the sense that you're not going to church every Sunday or sort of praying in a conventional way.
sentences.zh: 现在，我感觉你并不是每周都去教堂，或者以传统方式祈祷。

sentences.en: So, what is God to you?
sentences.zh: 那么，上帝对你来说是什么？

sentences.en: Well, it's a touchy subject, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是一个敏感的话题，不是吗？

sentences.en: Because I'm religion and, you know, but what happened that morning when that voice said, it's over, now you can start living, and it has all been for a purpose.
sentences.zh: 因为我不是宗教人士，你知道，但那天早上发生的事情，当那个声音说，一切都结束了，现在你可以开始生活了，这一切都是有目的的。

sentences.en: So, don't forget one moment of it.
sentences.zh: 所以，不要忘记其中的任何一刻。

sentences.en: I knew that was a power way beyond my understanding.
sentences.zh: 我知道那是一种远超我理解的力量。

sentences.en: Not up there in the clouds, but here, in here.
sentences.zh: 不是在云端之上，而是在这里，在这里面。

sentences.en: So, I chose to call it at that moment, God.
sentences.zh: 所以，在那一刻，我选择称它为上帝。

sentences.en: I didn't know what else to call it.
sentences.zh: 我不知道还能叫它什么。

sentences.en: Short word, God, easy to spell.
sentences.zh: 简短的词，上帝，拼写简单。

sentences.en: And I recently wrote a piece of music which was conducted in Riyadh, Goodbye, on piano and orchestra.
sentences.zh: 我最近写了一段音乐，在利雅得指挥演出，叫《再见》，用钢琴和管弦乐。

sentences.en: And at the end, it came to me as I was writing it, as I was composing it, that that's it.
sentences.zh: 在结尾时，当我写它、创作它的时候，我突然意识到，就是这样。

sentences.en: We come full circle.
sentences.zh: 我们绕了一圈又回到了原点。

sentences.en: And we dipped down to, that's all, folks.
sentences.zh: 我们沉下去，就这样了，各位。

sentences.en: And that, it was all a dream anyway.
sentences.zh: 而且，反正这一切都只是一场梦。

sentences.en: Everything is a dream.
sentences.zh: 万物皆为梦。

sentences.en: And it's goodbye before death takes us.
sentences.zh: 在死亡带走我们之前，这就是告别。

sentences.en: If you're getting nearer to the big goodbye, do you take any pride or draw any meaning or take any solace from what you leave behind, both as a person and as an artist?
sentences.zh: 如果你越来越接近那场盛大的告别，你会为你留下的东西感到自豪，或者从中汲取意义或慰藉吗？无论是作为一个人还是作为一名艺术家。

sentences.en: Oh, you mean a heritage.
sentences.zh: 哦，你是说遗产。

sentences.en: A legacy.
sentences.zh: 传承。

sentences.en: A legacy.
sentences.zh: 遗产。

sentences.en: I'd never think about it.
sentences.zh: 我从不考虑它。

sentences.en: I never think about it.
sentences.zh: 我从不考虑它。

sentences.en: When they cover the earth over you, that's it.
sentences.zh: 当泥土覆盖在你身上时，一切就结束了。

sentences.en: We move on.
sentences.zh: 我们继续前行。

sentences.en: I remember going to, I was asked by the widow of Lawrence Lever, Joan Plowrett, if I would read the last lines of King Lear at the casket in this little church in Sussex.
sentences.zh: 我记得劳伦斯·奥利弗的遗孀琼·普洛莱特曾请求我，在萨塞克斯郡的一座小教堂里，在灵柩前朗读《李尔王》的最后几行台词。

sentences.en: I was astounded that I was asked to do it.
sentences.zh: 我很惊讶她会请我做这件事。

sentences.en: And there was Olivia's casket, full of the flowers and wreaths and collections of flowers from Shakespeare's Winter's Tale.
sentences.zh: 奥利弗的灵柩就在那里，摆满了鲜花、花圈，还有来自莎士比亚《冬天的故事》里的花束。

sentences.en: And after that, we got into our cars and we went to the crematorium and I was sitting next to Maggie Smith, the great actress Maggie Smith.
sentences.zh: 在那之后，我们上了车前往火葬场，我坐在伟大的女演员玛吉·史密斯旁边。

sentences.en: I didn't know her that well, but we were sitting next to each other.
sentences.zh: 我不太了解她，但我们坐在一起。

sentences.en: And we both worked with Olivia.
sentences.zh: 我们都和奥利弗合作过。

sentences.en: And there was the casket and finally there was the curtain, you could hear the rollers taking them into the crematorium, into the flames.
sentences.zh: 灵柩就在那里，最后幕布拉上，你能听到滚轮把他们送进火葬场，送进火焰中。

sentences.en: Maggie Smith said, what a final curtain.
sentences.zh: 玛吉·史密斯说，多么完美的谢幕。

sentences.en: And you think, God almighty, what is it all about?
sentences.zh: 你会想，天哪，这一切到底是为了什么？

sentences.en: The wonder of all that energy that had gone into his life or anyone's life, not just a celebrity, but anyone's life.
sentences.zh: 他一生中投入的所有能量的奇迹，或者任何人的生命，不仅仅是名人，而是任何人的生命。

sentences.en: The energy that goes into survival.
sentences.zh: 投入到生存中的能量。

sentences.en: Seeing my own father dying, you know, going to the hospital the night he died.
sentences.zh: 看着我自己的父亲去世，你知道，在他去世的那晚去医院。

sentences.en: And standing at the foot of his bed, my mother smoothing his hair.
sentences.zh: 站在他的床脚，我母亲在抚摸他的头发。

sentences.en: And I felt his feet at the foot of the bed.
sentences.zh: 我摸到了他床脚的脚。

sentences.en: They were dead cold.
sentences.zh: 它们已经冰凉了。

sentences.en: He'd gone.
sentences.zh: 他走了。

sentences.en: And as I stood there, that silent night in that empty sounding hospital in South Wales,
sentences.zh: 当我站在那里，在南威尔士那家空荡荡的医院里，那个寂静的夜晚，

sentences.en: a voice again came to me, you're not so hot either.
sentences.zh: 一个声音再次传来，你也没什么了不起的。

sentences.en: This is what will happen to you.
sentences.zh: 这就是你将会发生的事情。

sentences.en: And it's a great wake-up call when you know that.
sentences.zh: 当你意识到这一点时，这是一个很好的警钟。

sentences.en: It's a fairly brusque voice.
sentences.zh: 那是一个相当生硬的声音。

sentences.en: You're not so hot.
sentences.zh: 你没什么了不起的。

sentences.en: But what it is, it's an awakening, several awakenings and epiphanies.
sentences.zh: 但它是什么呢？它是一种觉醒，几次觉醒和顿悟。

sentences.en: We think, yeah, that's right.
sentences.zh: 我们想，是的，没错。

sentences.en: But Sir Anthony, I realize I'm dancing around a question that I would like your answer to.
sentences.zh: 但是安东尼爵士，我意识到我在回避一个我想要你回答的问题。

sentences.en: Do you think your life has had meaning?
sentences.zh: 你认为你的人生有意义吗？

sentences.en: The only meaning I can put to it is that everything I sought and yearned for found me.
sentences.zh: 我能赋予它的唯一意义就是，我所寻求和渴望的一切都找到了我。

sentences.en: I didn't find it.
sentences.zh: 不是我找到了它们。

sentences.en: It came to me.
sentences.zh: 是它们来到我身边的。

sentences.en: After the break, a poetry reading by Sir Anthony Hopkins.
sentences.zh: 广告之后，将由安东尼·霍普金斯爵士为您朗读诗歌。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜露。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我负责编写《纽约时报》游戏板块中的《Connections》游戏。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我热爱恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我也喜欢尝试捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·阿泽斯基。

sentences.en: And I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我每天负责创作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“联觉”的特质。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像刚才那几位一样的人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games 即可开始游玩。

sentences.en: Hi, Tony.
sentences.zh: 你好，托尼。

sentences.en: Hello, is that David?
sentences.zh: 你好，是大卫吗？

sentences.en: It is David.
sentences.zh: 是我，大卫。

sentences.en: How are you?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: Good.
sentences.zh: 很好。

sentences.en: Good.
sentences.zh: 很好。

sentences.en: So I, of course, saw that at the end of your book, there's an appendix that includes a handful of poems, which is something I'd never seen done in an autobiography before.
sentences.zh: 当然，我注意到在你的书末尾附录里收录了几首诗，这在自传中是我从未见过的。

sentences.en: Can you tell me why you decided to include those poems?
sentences.zh: 能告诉我你决定收录这些诗的原因吗？

sentences.en: When I was a kid, I learned a lot of poems, a lot of words.
sentences.zh: 我小时候学过很多诗，也学过很多词汇。

sentences.en: And I was very moved by them from, I think, from about the age of 11.
sentences.zh: 我想从11岁左右开始，我就深受它们触动。

sentences.en: There was one occasion.
sentences.zh: 有一次。

sentences.en: I was in school.
sentences.zh: 我在学校里。

sentences.en: I was sitting in the back of the classroom where I always sat, sullenly, not wanting to be involved in anything.
sentences.zh: 我坐在教室后排，那是我一贯的位置，闷闷不乐，不想参与任何事情。

sentences.en: And the English teacher called me, said, I want you to come up here to the front of the class.
sentences.zh: 英语老师叫我，说：“我要你到教室前面来。”

sentences.en: I thought, what for?
sentences.zh: 我想，干什么？

sentences.en: He said, I want you to read this poem.
sentences.zh: 他说：“我要你读这首诗。”

sentences.en: He seemed to have an instinct about me that I knew something.
sentences.zh: 他似乎有一种直觉，觉得我懂点什么。

sentences.en: And he handed me a poem, which was West Wing by John Macefield.
sentences.zh: 他递给我一首诗，是约翰·梅斯菲尔德的《西风》。

sentences.en: He said, read that.
sentences.zh: 他说，读出来。

sentences.en: He said, out loud.
sentences.zh: 他说，大声读出来。

sentences.en: I read it and I was strangely moved by it.
sentences.zh: 我读了，并且奇怪地被它打动了。

sentences.en: And at the end, he said, I'm, that's it.
sentences.zh: 最后，他说：“好了，就这样。”

sentences.en: Okay, good.
sentences.zh: 好的，很好。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: That's very good.
sentences.zh: 非常好。

sentences.en: So it was my first good review, I think.
sentences.zh: 我想，这是我得到的第一个好评。

sentences.en: And I think that's what it is.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这就是它的意义所在。

sentences.en: It's an expression of my life.
sentences.zh: 它是对我人生的表达。

sentences.en: I read poems and I get kind of, yeah, I get moved by them.
sentences.zh: 我读诗，然后我就会，是的，我会被它们触动。

sentences.en: And I don't know why.
sentences.zh: 我也不知道为什么。

sentences.en: I think it's to do with my age and how poetry digs really deep inside us, you know, beyond our understanding.
sentences.zh: 我想这与我的年龄有关，也与诗歌如何深入我们内心有关，你知道，超出了我们的理解范围。

sentences.en: Would you be willing to read The West Wing by John Macefield?
sentences.zh: 你愿意读一下约翰·梅斯菲尔德的《西风》吗？

sentences.en: That is one of the poems that you included in the appendix.
sentences.zh: 那是你附录中收录的诗歌之一。

sentences.en: Let me just find that.
sentences.zh: 让我找一下。

sentences.en: Can I, have I got a minute?
sentences.zh: 可以吗，我有一分钟时间吗？

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 可以。

sentences.en: Hold on a second.
sentences.zh: 稍等一下。

sentences.en: Ah, well, yeah.
sentences.zh: 啊，好吧，好的。

sentences.en: It's a warm wind, the west wind, full of birds' cries.
sentences.zh: 那是温暖的风，西风，充满了鸟儿的啼鸣。

sentences.en: I never hear the west wind, but tears are in my eyes.
sentences.zh: 我从未听过西风，却已热泪盈眶。

sentences.en: For it comes from the westlands, the old brown hills, and aprils in the west wind, and daffodils.
sentences.zh: 因为它来自西方的土地，那古老的棕色山丘，四月在西风中，还有水仙花。

sentences.en: It's a fine land, the west land, for hearts as tired as mine.
sentences.zh: 那是一片美好的土地，西方的土地，适合像我这样疲惫的心灵。

sentences.en: Apple orchards blossom there, the air's like wine.
sentences.zh: 苹果园在那里开花，空气如美酒般醇厚。

sentences.en: There is cool green grass there, where men may lie at reSt.
sentences.zh: 那里有凉爽的绿草，人们可以躺下休憩。

sentences.en: And the thrushes are in song there, fluting in the neSt.
sentences.zh: 画眉鸟在那里歌唱，在巢中吹奏着笛音。

sentences.en: Will you not come home, brother?
sentences.zh: 你不回家吗，兄弟？

sentences.en: You have been long away.
sentences.zh: 你已经离开太久了。

sentences.en: It's April and blossom time, and white is the May.
sentences.zh: 现在是四月，花开的时节，山楂花洁白如雪。

sentences.en: And bright is the sun, brother, and warm is the rain.
sentences.zh: 阳光明媚，兄弟，雨水温暖。

sentences.en: Will you not come home, brother, home to us again?
sentences.zh: 你不回家吗，兄弟，回到我们身边？

sentences.en: The young corn is green, brother, where the rabbits run, its blue sky and white clouds, and warm rain and sun.
sentences.zh: 嫩玉米是绿色的，兄弟，兔子在奔跑，蓝天白云，温暖的雨水和阳光。

sentences.en: It's song to a man's soul, brother, fire to man's brain, to hear the wild bees and see the merry spring again.
sentences.zh: 这是对灵魂的歌唱，兄弟，是对大脑的火焰，去听那野蜂的嗡鸣，去看那欢乐的春天重现。

sentences.en: Larks are singing in the west, brother, above the green wheat.
sentences.zh: 云雀在西方歌唱，兄弟，在绿色的麦田之上。

sentences.en: So will you not come home, brother, and rest your tired feet?
sentences.zh: 所以你不回家吗，兄弟，去歇歇你疲惫的双脚？

sentences.en: I have a balm for bruised hearts, brother, sleep for aching eyes, says the warm wind, the west wind, full of birds' cries.
sentences.zh: 我为受伤的心灵准备了香膏，兄弟，为酸痛的双眼准备了睡眠，温暖的西风如是说，充满了鸟儿的啼鸣。

sentences.en: It's the white road westward is the road I must tread, to the green grass, the cool grass, the rest for heart and head,
sentences.zh: 那条通往西方的白色道路是我必须踏上的路，去往那绿草地，那凉爽的草地，让心与头颅得到安息，

sentences.en: to the vials and the warm hearts, and the thrush's song, in the fine land, the west land, the land where I belong.
sentences.zh: 去往那山谷和温暖的心灵，去往画眉的歌声，在那美好的土地，西方的土地，我归属的土地。

sentences.en: I'd like to end on that eloquent grace note.
sentences.zh: 我想以这动人的余韵作为结束。

sentences.en: Sir Anthony Hopkins, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 安东尼·霍普金斯爵士，非常感谢您。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.zh: 以上是安东尼·霍普金斯爵士。

sentences.en: My experience with my second was I just felt like a tiger was chasing me every day.

sentences.en: I've had so much anxiety.

sentences.en: I had a nonstop intrusive thought that I was just like at the whim of.
sentences.zh: 我有一种挥之不去的强迫性念头，我完全受其摆布。

sentences.en: It like controlled me.

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》，我们正准备迎接节假日的待客之道。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人们宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要完全遮光才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否睡得不省人事。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线环境？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为那是非常具体的需求。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？
